fortunes.text: The feast you share tonight will feed more than your body.
A forgiveness you give today returns to you before the moon changes.
The hand you extend will be remembered longer than the gift you give.
You will receive what you need. It may not be what you asked for.
The prayer you whisper for someone else is the one most likely to be answered.
A child in your house will teach you something about joy tonight.
The clothes you wear are new. Let something inside you be new too.
You will be invited somewhere. Say yes, even if you're tired.
The sweetness you taste was made by hands that love you.
A relative you barely know will say the exact thing you need to hear.
The moon you see tonight has seen your ancestors. They are with you.
You will give more than you planned. That's the blessing.
The grudge you've been holding is heavier than the wrong. Put it down.
Someone who hurt you is thinking of you tonight. Forgive them in your heart, or don't. The choice is yours.
The abundance you celebrate was never only yours. Pass it on.
You will be tested by generosity. Give anyway.
The family tension you've been dreading will dissolve over something small.
A stranger's prayer will include you tonight. You will never know their name.
The thing you've been fasting from is not the thing that's been starving you.
You will be the reason someone feels at home today.
The wealth you accumulate will mean nothing. The wealth you distribute will mean everything.
You will understand forgiveness properly for the first time this Eid. It will not feel the way you expected.
The person you're avoiding is avoiding you for the same reason. One of you must break first.
Your gratitude this year will protect you from a hardship you cannot yet see.
You will be asked to lead a prayer, a gathering, or a conversation. You are ready.
This Eid, the blessing you give away will become the blessing that saves you.
The family you're born into and the family you choose will become one table. You are the reason.
Something you thought was lost forever will return to you before the next new moon. Do not ask how.
You'll eat too much sheer khurma. That's the point of Eid.
The new clothes will crease. The memories won't.
A tradition you revive tonight will outlast you.
The person who owes you an apology owes themselves one too. Let it go.
This Eid, you will understand that the greatest fortune is not what you receive, but what you're able to give.
